task: Fix #3710: markdown lint gate reports PASS when it selected zero files

decisions.chosen: Reproduce #3710: markdown lint gate returns PASS on zero selected files
decisions.rationale: Verified live with markdownlint-cli2 0.23.2: a file carrying MD041 and MD032 placed under .agents/ prints 'Linting: 0 files' and exits 0. .markdownlint-cli2.yaml excludes 3,529 of 3,935 tracked markdown files (89.7%) through 44 ignores patterns.
